Theme

Latin word

prīmus

prīmus, prīma, prīmum

adjective

basic, first, elementary (of lessons, rules, needs); early, the first part of; first; first, original; the beginning of, the front of

In this lexicon

  • basic

    the recommended word · classical · Tac. Dial. 30.1: prīma discentium elementa; Quint. 2.5.1: prīma rhētoricēs rudīmenta (Lewis & Short)

  • early

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BG 1.22: prīmā lūce (Lewis & Short); Cato RR 50: prīmō vēre (Lewis & Short); Traupman 86: in the early evening, prīmā vesperā

  • first

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 253

  • original

    the recommended word · classical · Verg. A. 1.372: prīmā repetēns ab orīgine

  • the top of

    also used · classical · Liv. 21.33.1: prīmā deinde lūce
